{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''Sun & Moon'' home video releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon|Pocket Monsters Sun & Moon]]'' of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ==Volume releases== ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon|Pocket Monsters Sun & Moon]]'' was released by [[Shogakukan]] from 2017 to 2020. It consists of 49 volumes with all the [[List of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon episodes|146 episodes]] across them combined. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background:#{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
